hero.subtitle: Paste any public URL — your app, a client's site, or a competitor's — and get a plain-English security report in under 10 minutes. No installs, no agents.
hero.trustClaim: Critical and High findings require live confirmation — real data returned, real request succeeded — not just a pattern match.

problem.title: Common failures in fast-shipped apps
problem.subtitle: AI code generators are great for features, but they consistently miss security fundamentals. Don't let your launch turn into a breach.

items.title: Exposed API Keys
items.desc: Hardcoded credentials in client bundles or public endpoints without rate limiting.

items.title: Missing Auth Checks
items.desc: Routes that assume the frontend will hide them, leaving the API completely open.

items.title: No Security Headers
items.desc: Missing CSP, HSTS, and frame options making your app vulnerable to XSS and clickjacking.

howItWorks.title: How Seclayer Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to peace of mind.

steps.title: Paste Any URL
steps.desc: Drop in any publicly accessible URL — your own app, a client's site, or any live website.

steps.title: We Scan
steps.desc: Our engine crawls your pages, probes for exposed files and secrets, checks SSL, DNS, headers, and runs 137+ security checks — no agent needed.

steps.title: Get Report
steps.desc: DeepSeek AI translates the raw findings into a plain-English, actionable report.

aiBuilder.subtitle: VibeScan knows the specific risks that Lovable, Bolt, and Cursor-generated apps leave behind — including Supabase Row Level Security bypasses that expose your entire database to anonymous reads.

cards.title: Supabase RLS Bypass
cards.desc: Detects tables that return rows to unauthenticated requests because Row Level Security is disabled.

cards.title: service_role Key Leak
cards.desc: Finds Supabase service_role JWTs embedded in client-side code — they bypass all RLS policies (CVSS 10.0).

cards.title: AI-Builder Detection
cards.desc: Identifies apps built with Lovable, Bolt.new, Cursor, Firebase, and more — then applies targeted checks.

cards.title: GraphQL Introspection
cards.desc: Detects exposed GraphQL endpoints where schema introspection is left open — a common AI-scaffolded API mistake.

owasp.title: What Seclayer checks
owasp.subtitle: Every scan runs a comprehensive black-box suite targeting the most critical web security risks — without installing anything.

items.title: Broken Access Control
items.desc: Checks for publicly exposed admin routes, directory listing, and missing auth enforcement on crawled pages.

items.title: Cryptographic Failures
items.desc: SSL/TLS grade via Qualys SSL Labs, cipher strength, HSTS enforcement, and certificate validity.

items.title: Injection Risks
items.desc: Detects input reflection patterns, missing content-type validation, and error verbosity on probed endpoints.

items.title: Security Misconfiguration
items.desc: Security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, CORP, COOP), server version disclosure, debug modes, and open GraphQL introspection.

items.title: Vulnerable Components
items.desc: Technology fingerprinting — detects 30+ frameworks, CDNs, and AI-builder platforms, then cross-references known CVEs.

items.title: Auth & Session Flaws
items.desc: Cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), session fixation indicators, and Supabase RLS bypass detection.

items.title: Exposed Secrets & Files
items.desc: Actively probes for .env, .git/HEAD, .git/config, wp-config.php, phpinfo.php, backup.sql, and exposed API/OpenAPI specs.

items.title: Email Security (SPF & DMARC)
items.desc: Checks for missing or misconfigured SPF and DMARC records that let attackers send spoofed email from your domain.

items.title: Inner-Page Crawling
items.desc: Follows internal links to check sub-pages for config leaks, debug logs, exposed API docs, and environment files — not just the root.
